title: String split advances a caller-owned cursor (c)
description: The code splits with strsep, which advances a pointer the caller owns. A nested loop that reuses the same cursor consumes the outer iteration's remaining input, and the bug shows up as missing fields, not as an error.
remediation: Keep one cursor per parse, or copy the segment before splitting it, for example a copy of the segment for a nested parse.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the call without tracking cursor ownership.
